indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Ended a three-day winning streak even though most S&P 500 stocks rose; big tech did the damage.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Led the drop as Alphabet fell about 12% and software names sold off.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Caterpillar's fall of more than 9% weighed on the Dow.

notes: Alphabet fell about 12% after missing profit estimates, reviving worries that AI spending won't pay off. Tech pulled the Nasdaq down even though most S&P 500 stocks rose.
Software was hit hardest: ServiceNow dropped more than 25% and Fortinet about 21%. Eli Lilly and DoorDash, which agreed to buy Instacart, gained.
After the bell, Amazon slid about 7% and Intel about 23% on a weak PC outlook, pointing to a soft start for Friday's session.
events: Fri 30 Oct: ExxonMobil and AbbVie earnings before the open; Q3 Employment Cost Index at 15:30 Doha time.
Next week: US midterm elections. The Fed held rates this week; the next decision is in December.
